detached_structure.evidence: A small dark object under the trees southwest of the house and a tiny structure near the lower edge could be sheds, but canopy and shadow make them impossible to confirm.

signals.notes: The tile center falls in a wooded gap, so the lot is taken to be the gray-roofed house to the right of center. It has a paved parking pad with two vehicles, and dense mature trees cover the western and central parts of the yard.
